scientific_integrity: The mathematical proof, self-contained reconstruction scripts, and output evidence are included. The same-model review is not independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts initially fixed configurations of the specified synchronous binary minority rule on C_n square K_3 for n>=3; does not characterize other periods, transient behavior, higher-width cylinders, or global maxima. The characteristic polynomial is an explicit exact-arithmetic identity and numerical checks do not replace the all-size argument. Historical priority is qualified, particularly concerning inaccessible full-text 1988 general cylindrical cellular-automata literature.
title: Exact minority fixed-state census and entropy on triangular cylinders
